::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 5th [1884]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Cambridge University Library Add 4251 (B)/1539
:::

Dear [Miss Gordon Cumming](people/person_571.qmd)

I had an intimation from the [publisher](people/person_1344.qmd) that he is going to change printers, and so that I must finish up all there is in type before August.  This is keeping you, as well as many other papers back, but I hope to be able to get them in then.[^1]

Something unexpected always happens when one hopes one has comfortable space  [Miss Sewell’s letters](other_books/otherbook_969.qmd) went on two numbers more than I reckoned on.

I have just got [Granite Crags](other_books/otherbook_970.qmd)

yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The existing printer was [Clay](organizations/other_173.qmd), the new one [Clowes](organizations/other_245.qmd). The article referred to here as awaiting publication was perhaps 'Cawnpore and Lucknow' *MP* (October 1884), 358-376.
